description: This Java source file defines the BinaryDataHandler class, which implements handling for complex observation data (specifically binary data such as files) within the OpenMRS platform. It provides methods to retrieve and save binary data files linked to observations, supporting the RAW_VIEW mode, and interacts with storage services to read/write data streams.

classes.name: BinaryDataHandler
classes.description: Handler for storing and retrieving complex observation data (binary files) within the OpenMRS system, implementing methods for data access and storage, and supporting the RAW_VIEW file format.

methods.name: BinaryDataHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing data formats and settings.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves the complex data (file) associated with an observation in the specified view, primarily handling RAW_VIEW, and injects metadata.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the list of supported views for this handler, currently only RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves the complex data from an observation into storage and updates the observation's valueComplex field, then clears the ComplexData to avoid duplication.
